## Diagnosis

The public probe's finite numbers hid a broken energy–force relationship at the edges of the compressed table. In `source/lib/src/tabulate.cc`, `locate_xx` / `locate_xx_se_t` mapped every out-of-support input onto a table row but **discarded the displacement**:
